comment_content:
Get a good understanding of what skills are required. Platforms have become
too commercial and make you feel you need to learn this , that and they
provide all that. Most of platforms have mastered this art. Remember, your
ability to think and solve is most important skill. For a data scientist -
more analytical skills are required. Try solving a lot of problems -
analytical, puzzles , guessestimates etc. Get your hands dirty - choose a
language like python and take a basic course or even a book will suffice. Get
overview of what it is capable of. Hit on data sets. "Machine Learning with
Python" is a course. Python is a tool/language , ML is a mathematical concept.
Master the tool and implement concept. Most of language capabilities are
understood while on practice. Stats, ML are concepts. Get the logic/math
behind it. Delve deep it into any good textbook. Forget about tool, when you
learn about concept My best piece of advise is don't subscribe for a platform
or a course. Be a explorer !! Tons of free resources available.. If possible
get a good mentor who can guide down the path.
